svg.text: From Python developer to solutions architect.
Led the design and rollout of Snowflake OpenFlow as the single ingestion platform for
HIPAA-regulated PHI: 800+ SQL Server tables, some over a billion rows, with SQL Server
Change Tracking and Snowpipe Streaming. Building Workday ingestion and event-driven
Architecting a FIPS 140-3, Business Critical Snowflake platform (Prod, Dev, DR) with Okta
SSO and SCIM, AWS PrivateLink and per-agency row-level isolation. Migrating VeriTracks
Retired SSIS for a Snowflake customer by migrating to OpenFlow on SPCS, with Git
integration and a monitoring UI. Set up Cortex Code for the team.
dbt medallion models, Airflow ELT, Fivetran CDC from SQL Server, Azure DevOps CI/CD,
Entra ID SSO, masking and row access policies; supported SOC 1 and SOC 2 audits.
Azure Databricks platform: ADLS Gen2, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog ABAC, Terraform;
PySpark pipelines with Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables.
Migrated Hive data from Hortonworks HDP to Cloudera CDP, rebuilding ACID tables where
Built pipelines and ETL with Spark, Hive, Hadoop and Sqoop, and Hive models for
warehousing and analytics; tuned partitions, bucketing and compression.
Set up database storage monitoring with alerts before capacity limits; mapped legacy
fields to a new schema in SQL and prepared data for reporting and predictive models.
